gloss: to swear; to vow; to pledge

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {誓|ちか}っていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to swear; to vow; to take an oath
definitions.explanation: To make a solemn promise or declaration, often with religious or formal significance.
To commit oneself firmly to a course of action or to another person.

examples.english: I swore never to lie again.

examples.japanese: ⟦{神|かみ}→神：02147_kami⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{誓|ちか}って、⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{無実|むじつ}→無実：09504_mujitsu⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: I swear to God, I am innocent.

examples.japanese: ⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦たち→たち：noentry⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{開会式|かいかいしき}→開会式：27306_kaikaishiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{正々堂々|せいせいどうどう}→正々堂々：25225_seiseidoudou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{戦|たたか}う→戦う：02071_tatakau⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{誓|ちか}った。
examples.english: The athletes vowed at the opening ceremony to compete fairly.

examples.japanese: ⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{二度|にど}→二度：09503_nido⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦しない→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{誓|ちか}った。
examples.english: I pledged to myself that I would never make the same mistake again.

notes:
{誓|ちか}う is transitive (⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧). It takes the object marker ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ for what is being sworn.

ASPECT (ている):
{誓|ちか}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ indicates an ongoing state of having made a vow, or the act of swearing in progress.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{愛|あい}→愛：02370_ai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{誓|ちか}う (to vow love)
- ⟦{忠誠|ちゅうせい}→忠誠：12593_chuusei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{誓|ちか}う (to pledge allegiance)
- ⟦{神|かみ}→神：02147_kami⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{誓|ちか}う (to swear to God)
- ～⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{誓|ちか}う (to vow to do ~)
- ～⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{誓|ちか}う: What is being sworn
- ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{誓|ちか}う: To whom/what one swears

Register: Neutral to formal. Used in serious contexts such as ceremonies, courts, and solemn promises.
